notes: Added a touch-friendly Clear button directly beside the barcode scanner field.
Clear empties both the visible scanner field and its pending barcode state, resets the prompt and immediately restores scanner focus without opening the phone keyboard.
The scanner row adapts to narrow phones by placing the Lookup and Clear controls beneath the full-width field.
The v0.18.4 four-drive Dashboard polling, dropdown contrast and Cockpit Terminal fixes are preserved.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.7 and all update installations remain manual-only.
